about: High or critical advisories in shipped packages that can't be fixed yet. Each needs a reason (why it can't be exploited, or what limits it) and a date to look again. scripts/audit-check.mjs fails CI for anything not listed here, and for anything past its date.

accepted.reason: Memory exhaustion needs a list with no length limit. Every list the gateway accepts from callers now has a maximum (chat messages 1,000, model tags 50; checked in services/gateway/src/routes). The other services only accept signed calls from the gateway. Fixed in zod 4, a breaking upgrade across all services.
